تنتهجون (form VII)
# تَنْتَهِجُونَ (tantahijūna) /tan.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# تُنْتَهَجُونَ (tuntahajūna) /tun.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
